batch_node.name: Aydlette VDR Profiles v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Seeds one governed profile, aydlette-starter: the method's global defaults with a starter theta. A provider copies it under its own profile_id and governs it; the batch imports once, and a profile edited afterwards is not overwritten.

node.description: The method's global defaults (decision-table combining function, needs map, effect and scale tables, severity fallback to technical impact, no SSVC overlay) with a starter theta. Copy it under your own profile_id and govern your own theta.

document.theta_rationale: STARTER VALUE, REPLACE IT. The method sets no default for theta (REQ-LEV-2): each provider governs and publishes its own, with its rationale. 0.10 is the value the paper's scenario boxes use and the one FIRST notes is commonly cited; it is here so the profile runs, not because it fits your remediation capacity.
